description: ART / DESIGN / DRAWING (the timeless sense): line, colour, composition, perspective, form, proportion, shading — a universal-region anchor. Focused timeless member concepts sharpening the diffuse art microtheory toward the universal world Cornelius Vane holds (drawing is as old as his age).

microtheory.name: art_design_drawing
microtheory.definition: The timeless craft of visual art and drawing: line and form, colour and value, composition and proportion, perspective and shading — the fundamentals a draughtsman of any age, Victorian or modern, works in.

concepts.name: line
concepts.definition: The fundamental mark of drawing, varying in weight and character.

concepts.name: colour
concepts.definition: The visual sensation of hue, governed by pigment and light.

concepts.name: composition
concepts.definition: The arrangement of elements within the picture frame.

concepts.name: perspective
concepts.definition: The method of representing depth on a flat surface via converging lines.

concepts.name: form
concepts.definition: The three-dimensional volume a drawing suggests through shading.

concepts.name: value
concepts.definition: The lightness or darkness of a tone, carrying form and depth.

concepts.name: palette
concepts.definition: The set of colours an artist selects and mixes for a work.

concepts.name: sketch
concepts.definition: A rapid, preliminary drawing capturing essentials.

concepts.name: proportion
concepts.definition: The relation of the sizes of a figure's parts to the whole.

concepts.name: shading
concepts.definition: The gradation of value that models form and light.

concepts.name: tone
concepts.definition: A gradation of light and dark independent of hue.

concepts.name: contour
concepts.definition: The outline that describes the edge of a form.

concepts.name: figure_drawing
concepts.definition: The study and depiction of the human form.

concepts.name: chiaroscuro
concepts.definition: The strong contrast of light and shade modelling three-dimensional form.
